integrity: Exact proof derived from full-branch coding, forbidden-word count, and finite-run optimization. Standalone exact-rational exhaustive checks supplement, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the dyadic limiter u=1/2, initially uniform distribution, preassigned schedules, and first genuine intervention; not eventual attraction or noisy maps. Unindexed stronger word-avoidance work and incomplete later-paper access remain originality risks.
title: Exact run-length activation laws and budget-optimal control batching in flat-top tent dynamics
